en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a large public square with a prominent fountain (statue of a female figure on top) in the center, surrounded by ornate historic buildings. Several people, men in hats and coats, and women in long dresses, are seen standing near or walking around the fountain. Trees, benches, and decorative lampposts are also visible, giving the impression of a formal city square. The reverse side of the postcard contains handwritten Swedish text, postal marks, a green Swedish stamp (5 öre denomination), and an address.
